newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian stocks end mixed, oil shares active.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian stocks end mixed, oil shares active.

text.p: Oil stocks were the most active on the Nigerian bourse on Thursday, in a volatile day of large deals on the Lagos exchange, dealers said.
The all-share index fell slightly to 8805.50 from 8809.53 on Wednesday.
Traders said continuing demand for equities boosted trade as nearly six million shares changed hands compared to just under four million on Wednesday.
"There are still a lot of people out there looking for bargains," said one trader.
Texaco Nigeria Plc led the gainers, closing 20 kobo higher at 45.50 naira on high demand while fellow oil stock Agip Nigeria Plc swung the other way shedding 20 kobo to 26.90.
Food and beverages were also active.

Nestle Nigeria Plc continued its steady upward movement this week, appreciating by 10 kobo to close at 70.20. Its main competitor in Nigeria, Cadbury Nigeria Plc on the other hand fell by the same margin to 39.80.
Anglo-Nigerian conglomerate UAC Nigeria Plc was up 10 kobo to 20.00 while its French counterpart CFAO Nigeria Plc dropped the same margin to 3.90 naira.
Construction giants Cappa & D'Alberto and Costain West Africa Plc each gained 10 kobo to close at 11.40 and 3.29, respectively.
Another big loser of the day was Nigeria Enamelware Plc, which shed 18 kobo to 6.20 naira.
